Perfect! After **Qxf2+ Kxf2**, Black wins White's queen (9 points). White loses the pinned queen because it cannot be defended due to the pin. This is a textbook exploitation of a pin—the piece is pinned to the king and cannot escape capture.

**Coaching note:** Your opponent's queen on f2 was pinned to their king by your queen on c5. Pinned pieces cannot move to safety, so they make perfect targets. When you spot a pinned enemy piece, check if you can capture it safely. Here, Qxf2+ wins the queen outright with check.
